data.name: Emraanun
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'imr' which means 'to be a rival', 'to strive', or 'to compete'. Emraanun is the name of Prophet Ibrahim's (Abraham) second son, Ismaeel, who was born to Hagar and raised in the desert. The name signifies the one who is a ruler and leader of the believers, and the one who strives and competes in the way of Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Emraanun holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic history as it is the name of Prophet Ibrahim's (Abraham) second son, Ismaeel, who is considered a pioneer of faith and perseverance in the face of hardship. Ismaeel's story is one of pure devotion and unwavering faith, as he along with his mother Hagar was abandoned in the desert with no resources but managed to survive with Allah's help. This name serves as a reminder of the strength and resilience of the Muslim community and the power of unwavering faith.
